verdicts.title: An exact algorithm for 1-in-3 SAT
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: 1-in-3 SAT is an NP-complete variant of 3-SAT\ where a "clause" is satisfied iff exactly one of its three literal is satisfied. We present here an exact algorithm solving \oit\ in time $O^*(1.260^n)$.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract describes an 'exact algorithm solving' 1-in-3 SAT in time O*(1.260^n), which concerns algorithmic complexity of a SAT variant and says nothing about cohomotopy classes, simplicial complexes, or resolution width.

verdicts.title: On simplified NP-complete variants of Not-All-Equal 3-Sat and 3-Sat
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
We consider simplified, monotone versions of Not-All-Equal 3-Sat and 3-Sat, variants of the famous Satisfiability Problem where each clause is made up of exactly three distinct literals. verdicts.title: Unsatisfiable CNF Formulas need many Conflicts

A CNF formula without any conflicts is satisfiable. The Lovasz Local Lemma implies that a k-CNF formula is satisfiable if each clause conflicts with at most 2^k/e-1 clauses. verdicts.title: Erdős-Selfridge Theorem for Nonmonotone CNFs
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:

verdicts.title: Algebraic homotopy classes of rational functions
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We compute the set of naive pointed homotopy classes of endomorphisms of the projective line P^1 over the spectrum of a field. Our computation compares well with Fabien Morel's one of the motivic pointed homotopy classes of endomorphisms of P^1: there is an a priori monoid structure on the set of naive homotopy classes such that canonical map from this monoid to group of motivic homotopy classes is a group completion.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns naive homotopy classes of endomorphisms of P^1 over a field and their comparison to Morel's motivic homotopy classes — it says nothing about clause-link complexes, 3-SAT, or resolution width.
